content.rendered:
Monster Dash – 10/17/2023

The PSO is hosting the first ever Monster Dash! It is a fun, seasonally themed obstacle course for the kids that will take place during their PE period on October 17th. Students will spend approximately 15 minutes on the track traversing the obstacles while we as parents either chase them, jump out and scare them, or a combination of the two, all while dressed as monsters. We are encouraging parents to come watch as well as volunteer.

To volunteer, sign up on the Sign Up Genius link below.

Link: https://www.signupgenius.com/go/30E0449AFAA23A6FB6-44801228-themonster–

Retake day is quickly approaching. If we did not see you on picture day or you would like a new image, Dorian Studio will be taking pictures at your school again soon. Do not miss out on ordering pictures of your student.

Picture Retakes – 10/20/2023

Picture retakes will take place on October 20th.

Did you miss picture day or want to take a new picture?

Orders may be placed online by searching for your school name at mydorian.com and selecting the green Order button next to your school retake day event. Online orders are available up to 4 days after retake day. If you already ordered and want a new picture taken please be sure to return your original picture packet to the photographer on retake day.

Monster Dash Pledge Envelopes Due – 10/20/2023

Pledge Envelopes for the Monster Dash are due on October 20th.

Freaky Friday – 10/20/2023

Join us for Freaky Friday (a family event) on October 20th at 5pm to 8pm for an evening of food, games and prizes. Get excited because this year our PSO has added a new Haunted Maze!

There is also an SMS Student ONLY Dance that same evening from 8pm to 9:30pm. Important Reminder: Students must show their I.D. or StudentVue to enter (no exceptions) along with their dance ticket.

We are looking for Volunteers for Freaky Friday. Please click the link below to help make Freaky Friday a success!

Pre-Sale Tickets will be available all next week during lunch in the Student Store. Students may bring cash, check, Venmo, Apple Pay or Debit Card to process payment. Tickets will also be for sale through Venmo (student name and grade required in transaction details) with bracelet pick up at the Freaky Friday – see QR code below to process that today!

Please follow us on Facebook or Instagram for daily information on this event!

Link: https://www.signupgenius.com/go/30E0449AFAA23A6FB6-44937312-freaky
